clips.title: Meet Renovate - Your Update Automation Bot for Kubernetes and More!
clips.why: Renovate in less than two minutes: what it reads, and what it opens.
look: Renovate finds dependencies in many kinds of files, not only package.json.
It opens a pull request for each update or group.
Everything it does is driven by a config file in the repo.
clips.after: In fcp it reads npm, Python, Dockerfiles and the pinned actions in our workflows, all from one renovate.json5.

clips.title: Automating dependency updates - Dependabot vs Renovate
clips.why: A short comparison that explains what Renovate adds over GitHub's own Dependabot.
look: What Renovate can do that Dependabot cannot, in her comparison.
How much of Renovate's behaviour comes from configuration and presets.
clips.after: That is why fcp keeps Dependabot only for security alerts and lets Renovate open the monthly, grouped PRs.

practice.q: Which manager reads the uses: lines in .github/workflows, including pinned hashes and their version comments?

options.why: npm reads package.json and its lockfile.
It understands uses: lines, updates the hash and the # version comment together, and groups them if you ask.
dockerfile reads FROM lines in Dockerfiles.

practice.q: Finish the rule that gives every major update a PR of its own.
practice.hint: The value that removes a group.
practice.why: groupName: null takes majors out of whatever group an earlier rule put them in, as long as this rule comes later.

practice.q: Finish the setting that keeps any version younger than a week away from us.
practice.hint: Three words in camelCase: minimum, release, age.
practice.why: minimumReleaseAge holds young versions back as pending, which gives the community time to find broken or hijacked releases.

practice.q: Put one monthly Renovate cycle in order.
items: On the 1st, the nightly workflow mints an App token and runs Renovate
Renovate's managers read package.json, workflows and Dockerfiles
Renovate looks up newer versions and drops those younger than 7 days
packageRules decide the groups, and Renovate opens one PR per branch
On later nights, Renovate rebases its open PRs on main
practice.why: Finding comes before filtering, and filtering before grouping. The nightly runs after the 1st keep the PRs mergeable without opening new ones.

practice.q: The config asks for a post-upgrade command that is not in RENOVATE_ALLOWED_COMMANDS. What happens?

options.text: Renovate runs it, because the config asked for it
options.why: The config lives in the repo, where any PR can change it. The allowed list lives in the workflow on purpose.
Only commands that match the allowed list run, so a changed config cannot run anything new on our runner.
The workflow starts normally. Renovate itself refuses the command when it gets there.
